decisions.slice: I-4-4D4: migrate the impl-review-loop Skill entrypoint, the 3 main Agent definitions (implementation-worker / test-runner / pr-reviewer), the 2 step runbooks, the read-only CI helpers (wait_ci_checks / get_ci_failed_log, .py and .sh) and their source tests, and restore the C2 SKILL.md wording test. No wrapper, shared schema or permanent gate is added; the existing runner is reused.
decisions.auto_invocation: SKILL.md carries a temporary `disable-model-invocation: true` (Claude Code official Skill spec: Claude cannot invoke it on its own; a manual /impl-review-loop is still possible, so the body states the fail-closed rule: no Step 1/2/4/5 dispatch while the dependencies are unmigrated). It is not a permanent gate; releasing it is a decision for the slice that completes and verifies the wiring.
decisions.no_dispatch: Nothing here starts an Agent or SubAgent, runs the loop, calls live GitHub write operations, mutates a Git ref or publishes a PR. The read-only helpers are exercised with a fake gh on PATH inside tmp_path.
decisions.legacy_content: Legacy pnpm / game-specific examples in test-runner.md and implementation-worker.md were replaced by the agent-platform contract (uv / pytest / ruff / scripts/check_public_hygiene.sh) and the machine-valid example and its test VC were re-hashed accordingly. The Issue #2656 / #2670 / #2892 specific exception sections and the legacy repository URL citation are kept as historical source text; they are inert here (their targets do not exist) and a migration-status note says so. The single legacy slug assertion in test_test_runner_report_contract.py was shortened so check_no_functional_slug.py keeps its detection power.
decisions.limited_deferral: Human decision 2026-11-09 (#95): test_wait_ci_checks.py::test_canonical_evaluator_consumers_use_same_function checks 3 consumer documents (pr-review-judge/SKILL.md, pr-reviewer-lite.md, steps/step-4-pr-review.md). The first two are not migrated and are outside the D4 Allowed Paths. The source test body and its 3-consumer assertion are kept byte-identical and the single function is listed in deferred_tests (explicit --deselect by the runner; not skip, not xfail). The deferral is not counted as PASS: 108 collected / 107 ran / 1 deferred.
decisions.agent_boundary: pr-reviewer.md keeps `skills: [pr-review-judge]`, tools Bash/Read/Grep/Glob and disallowedTools Edit/Write/MultiEdit unchanged, and (I-4-4D8, #103, owner decision) carries NO frontmatter `hooks`: the source hooks (.claude/hooks/pr_reviewer_guard.py) are intentionally not re-migrated and reintroducing them fails frontmatter_problems. Because the Agent has Bash, no technical denial of git / gh mutation is claimed; no-write is an operational instruction plus the trusted-orchestrator posting split. D4 never dispatches this Agent. Independent review uses another read-only SubAgent.
decisions.production_claim: Migrating these files does not make /impl-review-loop, implementation, PR publish, the Final Gate or LOOP_HANDOFF_RESULT_V1 wiring runnable.
decisions.note_i_4_4d5: I-4-4D5 (#97) migrated pr-review-judge/SKILL.md (temporary disable-model-invocation: true) and pr-reviewer-lite.md and removed the single deferral: 108 collected / 108 ran / 0 deferred. The pre-D5 values 108/107/1 are kept in historical_pre_d5. The pr_reviewer_guard hook is still unmigrated, so evidence_boundary.hook_effective_protection stays false.
decisions.agent_boundary_pre_d8: pr-reviewer.md keeps the source hooks (.claude/hooks/pr_reviewer_guard.py) and `skills: [pr-review-judge]` unchanged, and keeps disallowedTools Edit/Write/MultiEdit. Neither the hook file nor the pr-review-judge Skill is migrated, so the hook layer gives no effective protection yet; the read-only boundary currently rests on the tools / disallowedTools declaration only. D4 never dispatches this Agent. Independent review uses another read-only SubAgent.
decisions.hook_policy_d8: Superseded the D4 expectation that the hook declaration must stay. See docs/dev/i4-4d8-hookless-reviewer-manifest.json.
